title: Share XP with Others
description: XP Share lets players safely share experience using XP bottles
body:
**XP Share lets players safely share experience using XP bottles.**

**Features:**
- /xpdrop points or levels
- Supports vanilla Mending
- Shift + Right Click to instantly consume
- Direct give to other players
- Anti-lag: single XP orb, rate limits, cooldowns
- Hard caps (1K levels / 10M XP)
- Tamper-proof bottles
- Anvil & Grindstone protected
- Clean UI, short number formatting

**Commands:**

all commands are accessible by everyone and don't need [player] if you want to give it to yourself

- /xpdrop
- /xpdrop points <amount> [player]
- /xpdrop levels <amount> [player]

**Amounts:**
- all
- half
- quarter
- or a number

Server-friendly and vanilla-safe.
